training_marginality_upper_bound.warning: This only subtracts the five existing normalized formula sources. It does not subtract word-starter coverage or prove new runtime/model-call savings. Most selected occurrences are sentence clauses inside longer turns, not whole messages.

source_provenance.training: BlendedSkillTalk CC-BY-4.0; original source/hash and source-only ranking retained.
source_provenance.japanese: JMdict/EDRDG CC-BY-SA-4.0, exact pinned retained snapshot; same English gloss may have many senses/readings.
source_provenance.swahili: Kaikki/Wiktionary CC-BY-SA-4.0, exact pinned retained Swahili snapshot.
source_provenance.spanish: Only the bounded retained210per-word Kaikki/Wiktionary sources were searched;331actual records, CC-BY-SA-4.0. This is not an exhaustive Spanish dictionary scan.

next_phase: Root reviews source selection and likely marginal value before target authoring.

For each retained source variant, select an exact attested complete target or author a short unit with explicit primary grammar proof and independent semantic review; do not invent dictionary attestation.
Retain Japanese spelling/pronunciation/Latin reading as distinct fields; apply lexical pronunciation evidence rather than raw kana conversion.
Freeze target choices, scope/normalization policy and acceptance thresholds before any new disjoint evaluation outputs.
Keep complete-unit and in-message clause coverage/depth separate; existing starter/core/native provider controls remain unchanged.
limits: Training role-play frequency is not ordinary worldwide private-chat frequency.
Fifty variants are not expected to solve90%coverage; observed training whole-message opportunity is only58turns.
Previously reviewed/evaluated source strings cannot provide new blind evidence after these units are authored.
No runtime additions, new translation models or backend calls are authorized by this proposal.
